concepts.name: Cape of Good Hope
concepts.definition: Rocky headland on South Africa's Cape Peninsula, a historic maritime waypoint often mistaken for Africa's southern tip, which is actually Cape Agulhas to the southeast.

concepts.name: Cape Horn
concepts.definition: The southernmost headland of South America, on Chile's Hornos Island, marking the northern edge of the Drake Passage and long infamous for treacherous seas.

concepts.name: North Cape
concepts.definition: Cliff-topped cape on Magerøya island in northern Norway, popularly billed as Europe's northernmost point, though nearby Knivskjellodden and mainland Cape Nordkinn reach further north.
